Hi John — following up with the short note you requested and a couple of attachments. See answers inline below and attached: region_pinning_matrix.xlsx (updated), SOC2-Summary.pdf (redacted).

Replication / failover behavior (short note)
- Primary behavior: customer tenancy is pinned to a single production region. In the event of a region outage, we support controlled failover to a pre-approved secondary US region. Failover is initiated by either automated health checks or manual operator action depending on your SLA tier.
- KV cache behavior: on failover we evict short-term KV cache entries to avoid serving stale state. Critical persistent session state is replicated asynchronously to the secondary within our HA design.
- RTO / RPO: typical RTO for cross-region failover is 10-30 minutes for Dedicated customers (depends on model size and session concurrency); RPO is hourly by default for hosted customers and can be configured down to 15 minutes for Dedicated with additional replication options. We'll include concrete numbers in the contract appendix per your tier.

Encryption & backups
- All backups are encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Private and Dedicated; hosted customers can opt into a customer-managed key for extra control.
- Backups can be restricted to US regions only; we will not replicate backups outside the approved jurisdictions without a signed DPA.

Logs and PII handling
- By default we treat full prompt text as PII when a customer marks a dataset as sensitive. We offer both redaction pipelines and prompt-level hashing to reduce exposure. We will incorporate your redaction profile if you share it.
